research_focus.status: The specification method and its correctness chain are sufficiently established for the current research stage. Unsupported tasks still remain unsupported, but specification construction is no longer the main blocker.
research_focus.primary_goal: Close one decisive end-to-end case: either show that a naturally occurring bias propagates through a real training or inference path, or show and repair a consequential defect in a mainstream operator implementation.
research_focus.first_candidate: PyTorch Inductor avg_pool2d with ceil_mode in backward is the first mainstream-operator candidate. Its public task, complete forward/VJP binding and output difference are already established; the remaining work is practical source localization, a real repair, and an unchanged-input before/after evaluation.
research_focus.localization_goal: Replace the current expensive per-IR-node exactification workflow with repair-oriented localization over the actual operator call and dataflow. The result must identify the affected output/state, source region, mechanism and a source-level repair candidate, then validate the compiled repair.
acceptance: Use a natural, unplanted difference in a released mainstream implementation and a common supported configuration.
Keep K-G, G-f and K-f separate so numerical execution bias, task-formula error and state/provenance error are not conflated.
Localize without using the known fix as analyzer input; score whether the reported source region and mechanism contain the actual cause.
Apply a real source-level repair, recompile it, and show that the target difference disappears without breaking the other declared outputs or state.
For the propagation route, hold inputs fixed and show the local correction changes the declared downstream quantity in the predicted direction; a micro-kernel-only effect is insufficient.
Report cannot-decide cases instead of filling missing localization or downstream evidence by assumption.
research_focus.specification_role: Maintain and extend specifications only when the selected real case exposes a concrete missing formula, parameter, state, output or evaluator capability. Contract counts are not a current success metric.
